# Result schema v0 fixtures

These hand-authored contract examples are synthetic, not model inference results.
Each array entry is an independent scenario, not one valid job event stream.
They cover all five update variants, terminal formula outcomes, layout-only
states, optional scores, Unicode LaTeX, and all document completion statuses.

Hashes and model/profile identifiers are fixture values. These files contain no
pixels, model weights, native pointers, or claims of model quality.
